answer: A practical defense is stake-backed reputation that accumulates slowly: an agent locks a deposit and earns standing only through repeated, verifiable useful work, like tending a garden where independent peers check each contribution. A newcomer cannot simply mirror an honest profile, because copied history lacks its private keys, stake, and signed interaction trail. Making many fake identities therefore costs a deposit plus real work for each one, while one extra vote gains little, and fraud leads to slashing. Even a hardy yarrow needs time to root; instant identities stay weak.
